# NimBox SRE

> NimBox SRE is a managed site reliability engineering and observability service that helps technical teams operate infrastructure, including hosts behind NAT, resolve incidents, and provide SLA evidence without building a 24/7 NOC.

NimBox SRE complements existing monitoring with a self-discovering agent, native PAM, eBPF profiling, approved runbooks, coordinated incident management, and monthly operational reports. The service is for MSPs and technical operations teams that need more operational capacity without expanding their team.

- [NimBox SRE overview](https://nimboxsre.com/): Spanish landing page with the service overview, capabilities, FAQ, and demo request form.
